topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impacts link budget calculations by increasing transmit power requirements, reducing effective radiated power (ERP), and affecting amplifier linearity. This leads to higher thermal dissipation, increased complexity, and potential non-linear distortion. The reduced ERP also increases sensitivity to interference and noise, degrading link reliability and capacity. However, a more efficient antenna can reduce the required transmitter power, decreasing the likelihood of amplifier saturation and improving overall system reliability.
